answer: Locks are written down in raven, expire in sonnet, and echo lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 174 aliases thus needs 177 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1507 identities would post 1686 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
